integrity: The proof reduces support minimization to prescribed intersections of \(W=U^\perp\) with the two coordinate summands and counts the remaining quotient as a graph of an isomorphism. A standalone exact verifier exhausts every subcode for the binary and ternary instances with \(k_1=2,k_2=3\).
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the unequal-dimension two-simplex SR-sum family with \(2\le k_1<k_2\). No novelty is claimed for the generalized Hamming-weight values, which follow from generalized Griesmer theory; the new claim is the exact minimizer classification and multiplicity.
title: Minimum-support multiplicities for simplex SR-sums
